_readme: NYSE full-closure holidays and 13:00 ET early closes, published 3 years ahead (SPEC.md §24). Refresh annually against nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars. Dates below are the actual market-closure (observed) dates. NYSE observation rules: holiday on Sunday -> observed Monday; holiday on Saturday -> observed preceding Friday, EXCEPT when that Friday is the last business day of the year (so New Year's Day falling on Saturday is not observed at all — e.g. 2028).

holidays.name: Independence Day (observed)
holidays.note: July 4, 2026 falls on Saturday; observed Friday 2026-07-03

holidays.name: Juneteenth National Independence Day (observed)
holidays.note: June 19, 2027 falls on Saturday; observed Friday 2027-06-18

holidays.name: Independence Day (observed)
holidays.note: July 4, 2027 falls on Sunday; observed Monday 2027-07-05

holidays.name: Christmas Day (observed)
holidays.note: December 25, 2027 falls on Saturday; observed Friday 2027-12-24 — therefore 2027-12-23 is a FULL trading day, not an early close

holidays.name: Martin Luther King, Jr. Day
holidays.note: New Year's Day 2028 falls on Saturday 2028-01-01 and is NOT observed: the preceding Friday (2027-12-31) is the last business day of 2027, so per NYSE rules the market stays open and no New Year's closure occurs in 2028 (same as 2022)

holidays.name: Christmas Day
holidays.note: December 24, 2028 is a Sunday, so there is no Christmas Eve early close in 2028
